report.summary: Payments-api latency spiked due to downstream database bottlenecks caused by rolling out the unoptimized ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag on ledger-service.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Feature flag rollout of ledger.reconciliation_v2 introduced unoptimized queries saturating ledger-db CPU

supporting.note: Feature flag rollout increased to 100% just before latency and CPU spikes.
ledger-service logged feature flag active at 100%.
ledger-db CPU jumped to 94.84% right after the flag rollout.
ledger-db p99 latency spiked simultaneously with CPU.
payments-api p99 latency increased as a consequence of synchronous dependency on ledger-service/ledger-db.

contradicting.note: TLS deprecation warnings existed before the incident and do not correlate with the sudden onset.
upi-gateway latency remained completely stable throughout the incident window.

facts.text: payments-api p99 latency anomaly started at 2026-10-11T13:20:00+00:00 and peaked at 3521.46ms.
Feature flag ledger.reconciliation_v2 was rolled out from 10% to 100% at 2026-10-11T13:18:00+00:00.
ledger-db CPU usage spiked to 94.84% at 2026-10-11T13:34:00+00:00, with latency anomaly starting at 13:19:00+00:00.
TLS deprecation warnings in payments-api logs occurred continuously from 12:00:00+00:00 onwards.

assumptions: The ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag introduced new database queries or logic that lack proper indexing on ledger-db.
evidence_gaps: Detailed slow query text and execution plans from ledger-db were not directly available.

timeline.event: Telemetry window opens and TLS deprecation warnings begin logging in payments-api.
Feature flag ledger.reconciliation_v2 rollout increased from 10% to 100%.
ledger-service logs feature flag active at 100%.
ledger-db latency anomaly begins and CPU starts spiking.

recommended_actions.action: Roll back feature flag ledger.reconciliation_v2 to 10% or OFF.
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly mitigates the database CPU saturation caused by the new reconciliation code path.

recommended_actions.action: Audit and optimize queries executed by ledger.reconciliation_v2.
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensures future rollouts do not cause resource exhaustion on ledger-db.
